title: Fitting Ethics to a Profession
coreMove: Fit an ethical rule to the profession by tracing its real downside channels and incentives.
sourcePressure: This chapter applies skin in the game to professional roles, where abstract codes are weak without real exposure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing ethics to written codes, slogans, or reputation management.

sourceAnchors.name: professional ethics
sourceAnchors.detail: the source notes stress ethics shaped by real exposure rather than abstract codes alone
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A code is thin until it touches the professional consequence it claims to govern.

sourceAnchors.name: downside channels
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter asks where harm travels when professionals advise or intervene
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Ethics has to follow the path of damage, not the wording on the wall.

hook: opening by explaining Fitting Ethics to a Profession
counterintuition: Reducing ethics to written codes, slogans, or reputation management.
tryThisNow: make a pros and cons list with no exposure map
